issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other (Water 52,697.57 p1 + Sewer 13,490.96 p2)
issues.issue: The category is presumed because the page has no breakdown of the Water and Sewer funds' only receipt line. Defensible, but it is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Light Fund: Local Receipts: Other 21,095.67; General Government 953.50; transfers out 18,574.11 (p3)
issues.issue: The Light Fund is treated as governmental. A village 'Light Fund' is often an electric utility (for example, lease receipts from a power district), which would make it business-type. The fund type is not stated on the page.
